description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints the Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Theoretical Output 6–12 m³/h and Pumping Pressure 15 MPa. Output is a volume rate. Pre
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵的理论输送量印成6–12 m³/h，把泵送压力印成15 MPa。输送量是体积流量。压力是同一页上的另一格。标题为「Hydraulic machinery」的画面主体是液压 Force Torque 275px。这一帧没有印出这两格，也不会把别的厂家铭牌抄到这个型号上。

h1.en: How Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump Separates Pressure from Output
h1.zh: 拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵怎样把压力和输送量分成两格

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints the Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Theoretical Output 6–12 m³/h and Pumping Pressure 15 MPa. Output is a volume rate. Pressure is a separate cell on the same sheet. The frame titled “Hydraulic machinery” shows Hydraulic Force Torque 275px. That frame does not print these two cells, and another maker's plate is not copied onto this model.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵的理论输送量印成6–12 m³/h，把泵送压力印成15 MPa。输送量是体积流量。压力是同一页上的另一格。标题为「Hydraulic machinery」的画面主体是液压 Force Torque 275px。这一帧没有印出这两格，也不会把别的厂家铭牌抄到这个型号上。

body.en: On the Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump sheet, Theoretical Output is 6–12 m³/h and Pumping Pressure is 15 MPa. A piston pump pushes concrete into the line; a squeeze pump flattens a hose from outside. Either way, m³/h is not MPa. Hopper Capacity 0.25 m³. Max. Aggregate Size 1–3 cm. Total Weight 1300 kg.
body.zh: 在拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵这一页，理论输送量是6–12 m³/h，泵送压力是15 MPa。活塞泵把混凝土推进管路，挤压泵从外面压扁软管。无论哪一种，立方米每小时都不是兆帕。料斗容积 0.25 m³。最大骨料粒径 1–3 cm。整机重量 1300 kg。

heading.en: What the frame is allowed to show

body.en: The frame comes from en.wikipedia.org, page “Hydraulic machinery”. Its subject is Hydraulic Force Torque 275px. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not treat that caption as a nameplate for the Tractor-Driven 4100 Concrete Pump. Stroke length, cycle rate and price are absent from both the caption and this catalogue row.
body.zh: 这一帧来自 en.wikipedia.org 的页面「Hydraulic machinery」。画面主体是液压 Force Torque 275px。河北品锦机械不把这句说明当成拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵的铭牌。行程、冲次和价格在说明文字和这一行目录里都没有。

body.en: The Xingtai row does not print a service interval, a seal torque, an export destination or a job case. Hopper Capacity 0.25 m³. Max. Aggregate Size 1–3 cm. Total Weight 1300 kg. Those printed extras are still not a stroke length.
body.zh: 邢台这一行没有印保养小时间隔、密封扭矩、出口国家或工程案例。料斗容积 0.25 m³。最大骨料粒径 1–3 cm。整机重量 1300 kg。这些已印的附加格仍然不是行程。
